scope: Primary-source review and local book-data preparation; no model, teacher or training run

sources.unit: publisher blurb with hierarchical multi-label categories
sources.count_basis: Provider/paper report retained; acquired archive audited separately below
sources.terms: CC BY-NC 4.0; publisher retains blurb rights
sources.limit: audit editions/work groups; map publisher categories into separate field facets; no automatic commercial-use clearance
sources.hierarchy_count_note: Paper Table 1 reports levels 7/46/77/16; provider page gives an inconsistent final-level count. Count actual archive before freezing labels.
sources.audit_note: Proposed connected groups constrain known overlaps; bounded source inspection reviewed113rows and found cross-source matches including licensed Little Brother. Source metadata remains weak; agent field suggestions are not human labels or training gold.

sources.unit: identified catalogue work/edition and sourced headings
sources.role: primary topic evidence and weak supervision
sources.limit: 650 is topical; 655 is genre/form. Raw subjects and current display genres mix facets. Missing labels are unknown; a vocabulary is not a labeled corpus.

sources.unit: human response about a highlighted character in a passage
sources.limit: character emotion, affect-enriched sampling and excluded dialogue; not reader or whole-book mood. Keep raw t1 human labels separate from computational mappings.

sources.unit: Wikipedia plot summary plus Freebase-linked metadata
sources.role: secondary genre data or cross-style diagnostic
sources.limit: spoilers, incomplete and mixed genre labels; plot summaries differ from deployment blurbs

sources.unit: scholarly open-access book metadata and publisher-assigned Thema
sources.terms: provider states metadata CC0; book licenses separate; Thema has its own use conditions
sources.limit: audit abstracts, language, edition/chapter units; do not apply BGC ancestor rules blindly. FAQ read through index; recheck at acquisition.

sources.role: separate passage-affect diagnostic; do not pool as highlighted-character labels
sources.terms: paper offers access by request for noncommercial research
sources.limit: not whole-work reader mood; source-work identifiers and current delivery require verification

sources.unit: sentence valence/arousal/dominance from reader or writer perspective
sources.limit: use reader.csv, not blended emobank.csv; mixed domains and sentence scope
small and not book-length; no full-book mood claim

sources.unit: GPT-4o-derived affective/cognitive statements from Goodreads reviews
sources.role: reader-experience task design and optional weak labels, not evaluation gold
sources.limit: requests are derived from the same user review of the target book; prospective requests need separate collection. Provider reuse terms unresolved.

sources.role: EmoLit/EmotionArcs as later weak-label or feature candidates
sources.limit: entailment/pseudo-label or lexicon-derived signals, not independent human book-mood gold; code license does not settle text rights

methods.decision: Use positive/negative/unknown labels with masked supervision plus reviewed negatives or a separately justified positive-unlabeled method. Positive-only masked BCE can collapse to all-positive predictions.
Apply only reviewed parent-child implications; source taxonomies have different rules.
Store evidence spans/offsets and source hashes; plausible supporting spans do not prove faithful model reasoning.
Calibrate field thresholds on held-out books; report precision/coverage and abstain when source evidence is absent. Softmax confidence alone is inadequate under domain shift.
Optional later denoising on permitted training-book text. If used, all recipe arms share the same adapted base and its cost. Reported RoBERTa gains do not establish custom T5 gains.

cr4_release_observation.scope: Provider metadata, README and DDI schema only. No annotation table downloaded. Dataset-level license is a provider declaration, not per-excerpt rights verification.

not_selected.reason: Accessible description has seven tones, but annotation provenance, work grouping and reuse terms were not verified.
Inspected papers describe Goodreads/Gemini-derived processing; no reusable released corpus verified.

modern_book_sources.role: modern website catalogue and source links
modern_book_sources.decision: Use bounded identified work searches; metadata dumps for later scale. Public metadata/borrowing links do not supply blanket full-text training rights. Original-publication evidence is separate from edition dates.

modern_book_sources.role: modern scholarly nonfiction text, title-level selection
modern_book_sources.decision: DOAB discovery metadata is not the full-text license. OAPEN hosts texts; inspect publisher-assigned license and third-party exceptions per title. Strong nonfiction coverage, not a general modern-fiction corpus.

modern_book_sources.role: small explicitly licensed modern full-length fiction collection
modern_book_sources.decision: Pinned official Little Brother text acquired for a small preparation pilot; CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 with cover art excluded. Green Comet remains a CC BY-SA shortlist candidate. Preserve exact edition, attribution and obligations; no general commercial training clearance. Unglue.it is discovery, not a uniform license.

Three English source texts acquired with title-level CC BY 4.0 metadata and a pinned repository revision. Picture-book pages and translation units differ from novels; illustrations are omitted and one page has no text. A small preparation pilot, not representative adult-fiction coverage.

modern_book_sources.role: optional terms-compliant live lookup/preview, not a default permanent importer
modern_book_sources.decision: Check API content/caching and app-use terms. Preview/free-ebook availability is not a training license; do not assume permanent description/full-text corpus rights.

modern_book_sources.role: permission-required training candidate, not automatic clearance
modern_book_sources.decision: Current provider guidance lists CC BY-NC-SA4.0; the cited edition explicitly requires written permission for LLM/generative-AI training or ingestion. Check exact editions instead of relying on historical CC BY assumptions.
